highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.116.0 stabilizes the modernized 3.0 preview line with .NET 9 and WebAssembly improvements.
highlights_body: It rolls up the 3.0 previews, adds WebAssembly SIMD and threading support, expands span APIs, and fixes Blazor and platform rendering issues. Review the API migration notes before upgrading.

breaking.title: Previously obsolete APIs remain removed
breaking.body: The stable 3.116.0 release includes the v3 API cleanup from the preview line. Replace obsolete APIs with their documented alternatives and rebuild against the API-diff report.

breaking.title: Platform view APIs use modern targets
breaking.body: Platform view projects now follow the modern target-framework and package model. Update application project references and platform-specific integrations when moving from v2.

bullets.lead: Skia m116 and refreshed shaping stack
bullets.detail: Stabilizes the Skia m116 renderer and updated HarfBuzz stack introduced during the 3.0 preview cycle.
Adds span overloads for mapping points and vectors, adding polygons, color filters, rounded rectangles, and pixel access.
Adds blender, raw shader, picture-recording, desktop GL, accelerated WinUI, and Skottie animation-builder support.

bullets.lead: Web, Apple, Uno, and MAUI rendering fixes
bullets.detail: Corrects Blazor base-path and .NET 9 behavior, Uno canvas rendering, Metal snapshots, and MAUI view disposal.
Adds multi-threaded and SIMD WebAssembly builds while aligning SDKs, workloads, and platform targets with current .NET releases.

contributor_summaries.jeromelaban: Uno canvas and MAUI lifecycle reliability fixes
contributor_summaries.maxkatz6: Trimmable platform configuration and shared Metal target frameworks
contributor_summaries.Youssef1313: Uno rendering and sampling compatibility fixes
contributor_summaries.alexandrvslv: Span overloads for core geometry APIs

preview_summaries.v3.116.0-preview.6.1: Preview 6 finalized WebAssembly capabilities and the Skia update for the stable release.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.5.4: Preview 5 completed .NET 8 modernization, compatibility work, and native asset packaging.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.4.1: Preview 4 expanded graphics APIs and corrected platform rendering and lifetime behavior.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added desktop GL support, Blazor display-density support, and Metal rendering fixes.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animation and shader APIs alongside Mac Catalyst Metal support.
preview_summaries.v3.0.0-preview.1.8: Preview 1 established the SkiaSharp 3.0 API cleanup and modernized platform foundations.

harfbuzz_summary: Bundles the modernized HarfBuzz binding and shaping stack introduced during the 3.0 preview cycle.
